item.title: Jodi Benson To Star In INTO THE WOODS At Dr. Phillips Center’s Steinmetz Hall

item.title: Kennedy Center Honors to Be Renamed 'Trump Kennedy Center Honors' for 2026 Ceremony
item.description: The annual honors ceremony at The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts will be renamed the “Trump Kennedy Center Honors,” according to The New York Times. The change follows the board’s vote late last year to rename the Washington institution the Trump-Kennedy Center. A representative for the center said the honors’ rebranding “automatically follows” that of the institution.
